storage: Room temperature in a closed bottle, away from sunlight; no refrigeration needed. Keep it out of reach of children.
looksLike: A clear, colourless, sharp-smelling liquid in a plastic bottle.
howToPick: Look for "synthetic vinegar" and the acidity on the label (Indian rules require at least 3.75% acidity, per the compliance summary below), a clear liquid, and an intact seal. Brewed vinegar is labelled differently and costs more.
shelfLife: Very long when sealed; flavour holds for a year or more (general guidance; not from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 3 ml per serving (½ tsp, in the sauce)
